text.text_excerpt: Apparently much nicer in comparison to other locations (this was my first). Italian Pie has a large patio area to dine and/or drink, a large bar area with small tables, and a spacious dining room filled with natural sunlight. I stopped in for lunch, and was pleased by the long list of lunch combos, and noticed that its a great spot if there is a large group gathering for lunch. Great service, good food, and average prices. Nothing jumped out compelling me to return, however I noticed their phenomenal happy hour specials and I think that might just compel me. I look forward to returning for happy hour!

This place has an outdoor seating area that seemed nice, though it was raining when we went so I didn't bother. A large dining room and a bar area round it out. It was pretty empty when we went on a weeknight about 7pm, not sure if that's usual or not, but it was ok. On the quiet side, but acceptable. Pizza was pretty good. Ended up going during happy hour so drinks were 2-for-1, score! Had cannolis for dessert which almost took away a star. They were just not what I was expecting. The dough part of cannolis I had had before was thin and crispy, and these ones were thick and chewy. They tasted ok but were not really what I was looking for. An entire star of this review goes to our server,...

I was super excited to hear about a new pizza place moving in just a few blocks from my house. I gave them about a month or so to settle in and streamline their operation, and then meandered on over with a couple of friends. I'm super glad I did. This may be my new favorite pizza place in the city. The service was good, the pizza was not expensive and the crust was....just amazing. It reminds me of those Pizza Hut stuffed crust commercials from the past, that told you to eat the crust first. This crust is totally worthy of the "eat first" treatment.
